text.EN: I know water is what I need, but I can't give you an exact amount yet.
text.TL: Alam kong tubig ang kailangan ko, pero hindi ko pa masabi ang eksaktong dami.

text.EN: Even half a bottle of water would make a difference.
text.TL: Kahit kalahating botelya ng tubig ay malaking tulong na.

text.EN: Just enough clean water to wet my throat, please.
text.TL: Sapat lang na malinis na tubig pambasa ng lalamunan ko.

text.EN: A single flask or a few gulps would be fantastic.
text.TL: Kahit isang lagayan o ilang lagok ay napakaganda na.

text.EN: I'm parched. Any amount of safe water would help.
text.TL: Uhaw ako. Anumang dami ng ligtas na tubig ay makakatulong.

text.EN: Don't need a whole gallon, just enough to stay hydrated.
text.TL: Hindi kailangan ng galon, sapat lang para mawala ang uhaw.

text.EN: Whatever water you can afford to part with right now.
text.TL: Anumang tubig na kaya mong ibigay sa ngayon.

text.EN: A cup or a bottle, I won't turn it down.
text.TL: Kahit tasa o botelya, hindi ko tatanggihan.

text.EN: Enough water to get through the afternoon would be great.
text.TL: Sapat na tubig para maitawid ang hapon ay ayos na.

text.EN: Just a small sip or two to keep my strength up.
text.TL: Kahit isa o dalawang lagok lang para manatili ang lakas.
